phase_name: Rebase both Nix agents in nix/index-entries.json

objectives.description: Extract real @-reference sets for both Nix agents
objectives.note: nix-research-agent: unconditional (return-metadata-file.md core, report-format.md core, project/nix/README.md, project/nix/domain/nix-language.md) + 8 sub-task-gated files. nix-implementation-agent: unconditional (core bundle 5 files + README.md, nix-language.md, nix-style-guide.md) + 8 sub-task-gated files. Both agents had 12 hooked entries in nix/index-entries.json, matching the plan's Scope Hypothesis exactly. project/nix/tools/mcp-nixos-integration.md confirmed unreferenced by either agent's .md body (zero grep matches for both 'mcp-nixos-integration' and 'mcp_nixos').

objectives.description: nix-research-agent: keep only unconditional refs, move 8 sub-task-gated files to task_types-only
objectives.note: Dropped 11 of 12 hooked entries (all retained task_types:[nix], no on_demand needed), keeping only project/nix/domain/nix-language.md (1,720 tok) in the nix file. Added nix-research-agent to core-owned formats/return-metadata-file.md and formats/report-format.md.

objectives.description: Move project/nix/README.md to on_demand/task_types-only for margin (per research: agent computes exactly 8,000 with no margin otherwise)
objectives.note: README.md (808 tok) dropped from nix-research-agent's agents[] hook alongside the other 10 conditional/unreferenced entries in objective 2's single pass, despite being a genuine unconditional reference -- deliberately for margin, per the plan's explicit instruction. Result: nix-research-agent measures 7,192 (margin 808), not the bare-cap 8,000 the report predicted before this deliberate extra drop.

objectives.description: nix-implementation-agent: hook core bundle + 3 unconditional nix files, keep 8 sub-task-gated as task_types-only
objectives.note: Dropped 9 of 12 hooked entries (all retained task_types:[nix], no on_demand needed), keeping project/nix/README.md+domain/nix-language.md+standards/nix-style-guide.md (4,856 tok). Added nix-implementation-agent to the 5 core-owned core-bundle entries (previously not hooked to this agent at all).

objectives.description: Record git-staging-scope.md drop for Phase 3's owner (handled directly, core file)
objectives.note: Confirmed not @-referenced by nix-implementation-agent.md. Dropped nix-implementation-agent from standards/git-staging-scope.md's agents[]; commands[] hook (5 commands) kept it non-empty, no on_demand needed.

objectives.description: Verify: schema test, regenerate, measure both outcomes with margin
objectives.note: test-index-entries-schema.sh: 8/1 identical baseline. After deploy-headless.sh: nix-research-agent 7192/8000 OK (margin 808), nix-implementation-agent 14104/8000 OVER:6104 (exact report prediction, recorded for Phase 8). Dead Entry Check: 0. Overall Violations: 4 (down from 5).
